title: Add interactive installer wizard

context.summary: Add the interactive question layer that turns operator choices into installer answer files.
context.background: TASK-58 introduced a deterministic installer core. The next layer must prompt for domain, storage, antivirus, model roles, modalities, interfaces and tokens while staying testable through injectable IO.

in: Add wizard prompt metadata and stable prompt IDs.
Add injectable wizard IO and a Node readline adapter.
Prompt for install profile, MINDORY_HOME, public URL/domain, AV mode, storage, modalities, LLM roles/providers/models/resource hints, interfaces and tokens.
Generate a redacted confirmation preview before returning answers.
Block future/experimental LLM role enablement unless experimental mode is enabled.
Add validator coverage for prompt plan, scripted wizard flow, redaction and experimental gating.
out: Signal handling, repair and resume commands.

acceptance_criteria: Wizard prompts are derived from config catalog metadata where available.
Scripted wizard IO can produce a valid MindoryInstallAnswers object without a terminal.
Node readline adapter is available for real interactive use.
Redacted confirmation preview hides secrets before confirmation.
Experimental/future LLM roles cannot be enabled unless experimental mode is true.
Installer validator covers wizard prompt IDs and a scripted flow.

manual_checks: Confirm no bootstrap scripts or Compose execution are added.

risks: Prompt logic must remain testable and not depend on a real TTY.
Secrets must never appear in the confirmation preview.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
